findings.current: So were the fury and self-reproach he had been struggling to hold back since regaining consciousness. No matter how hard he suppressed them, they kept surging up from deep in his chest.
findings.defect: The source says Taekyung clenched his teeth both because of the pain and because he was suppressing the fury and self-reproach rising in him. “So were” breaks the connection to the clenching and leaves the sentence fragment unclear.
findings.rationale: The Korean links the emotional struggle to the same involuntary jaw-clenching caused by his physical pain; the accepted baseline preserves that link with “And against the fury and self-reproach…”.
findings.replacement: And he was also clenching his teeth against the fury and self-reproach he had been doing everything he could to hold back since regaining consciousness, though they kept surging up from deep in his chest.

summary: One minor fidelity issue: the translation obscures the emotional cause of Taekyung clenching his teeth.
